The agency chose MY 1976 as the base period from which to develop the AFES and to evaluate its environmental impact. The baseline for all projections is the EPA 1976 Light Duty Truck Data Base. For fuel economy projections, the 49 State (Federal) MY 1976 fuel economy for catalyst equipped vehicles was used. 1976 was chosen as the base year because it is the latest model year for which accurate hard data on vehicle attributes, fuel economy, and production mix exist. Moreover, MY 1976 reflects the most recent consumer buying habits in terms of production mix. It is assumed for GM and Ford that their captive imports are a part of their production. However, little fuel economy improvement is projected for captive imports between MY 1976 and MY 1979, and their effect on fleet average fuel economy is considered based on their 1976 sales volumes.
